_doc: Life Manager OpenClaw cron-COMMAND jobs (B2). COMMAND payloads run deterministic node scripts on the Gateway host, spend ZERO model tokens (docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs), and take over the Railway Node app's setInterval loops at cutover (B4). SINGLE-WRITER MIGRATION (race truth): only WAKE is race-safe (lm_wake_log atomic unique(uid,event_key) -> 409). TRAVEL and ASK dedup is an in-memory read-then-write ([Travel] scan in lib/travel.js; lm_ask_log SELECT-then-POST in lib/ask.js) with NO atomic unique constraint, so running the Railway scheduler AND these cron jobs at the SAME time can double-insert a [Travel] block or double-ask. THEREFORE B4 cutover must be a single-writer SWITCH: disable the Railway start*Loop() loops as you enable these cron jobs; do NOT run both at once. (Follow-up hardening C-H1: give [Travel]+lm_ask_log atomic unique constraints like lm_wake_log.) The scripts loop ALL lm_users rows (shared multi-tenant). commandCwd is the apps/life-call dir on the gateway host, supplied at registration via LIFE_CALL_DIR, not hardcoded. Requires openclaw>=2026.6.10 (command-cron); live registration = B4 on the product gateway.
